conventions.evidenceTags: DC ids, S ids, or section refs like L09-M6; inferred=true marks synthesis choices

dials.definition: How much the interface performs on everyday screens.

drives.note: capped by density; 1.125 is the productive low end
at most three weights on a page (owner, 2026-11-05: a private B2B landing page loaded weights 300 to 700); four only when chosen (Q-type-12)
marketing surfaces only: the hero size at desktop width, on its own fluid display scale (formulas.type.display)

dials.definition: How much the product looks like the brand versus the platform. Calibrated to L09 Y score x 10.
How much information fits on a screen.
How lively the interface feels in motion and intensity.

drives.note: on a page with two weights (type.weightCount 2, Expression 0-33) headings snap to 600, or 700 when the band gives 700 or more, so the page keeps two weights (engine.py build_typography). DESIGN.md's Energy line reports the weight the tokens hold (issue 69)

dials.definition: Corner radius of the default control and everything derived from it.

drives.note: these bands apply when the corners are a choice: Q-shape-01, the Roundness dial set by hand, a style or a picked preset. Otherwise formulas.radius.unchosen keeps the control radius between 6 and 12 px, so 0 or 2 becomes 6 and 16 or full becomes 12 (engine.py build_shape). DESIGN.md's Roundness line reports the radius the tokens hold (issue 69)

dials.definition: How strongly surfaces separate in the third dimension (ordinal bands of depth models).

drives.note: a style or preset with its own build (offset, extruded, clay, in styles.json) replaces the band, and an override replaces both (engine.py Ctx.elevation_model). DESIGN.md's Depth line reports the model the tokens use (issue 69)

dials.definition: How much chroma the palette carries and how much of the screen it covers.

drives.note: anchors: Monochrome, Neutral 8-12, TonalSpot 32-36, Expressive 48, Vibrant max

dials.definition: Temperature of the neutrals and formality of the details around them.

drives.note: Tailwind slate, gray, neutral, stone, taupe at step 500; ends of ramp keep c <= 0.008

coupling.appliesTo: character dials the user has not touched

rules.formula: 40 + 0.5*(expression-50); materials band only if expression>60 and platform supports materials

raw.note: GOV.UK yellow #ffdd00

macroRules.conflict: if two active macros push one dial in opposite directions, show the conflict; do not average silently

brandFloor.rule: when a brand color exists and the person did not set Colorfulness, feel words and presets may not push it below the tonal band (36), so the brand never disappears and primary buttons never turn gray

profiles.about: Default profiles: values the engine uses, when a trigger holds, for what the person has not answered, set or locked. A profile never overrides a choice: an item is skipped when its question is answered, its dial or value was set, overridden or locked, or a brand color already decides it. Each applied item is recorded as auto_default with its reason (opendesigner.meta.json profile, decisions.md, DESIGN.md Open Items); the person confirms or changes it like any other value.

persuade.name: Marketing page
persuade.why: A page that sells needs room, one hero line and a clear button. Feel words such as serious or minimal otherwise give it a 1.2 scale, no hero moment and comfortable spacing, as on a private B2B landing page (2026-11-05).

spacing.what: Spacious spacing by default, with 48px controls (buttons on the page 48 to 56px)
spacing.note: Inferred: Persuade surfaces are spacious (Q-scope-06 surface modes); Carbon calls 48px the most common button size (S-L03-082).

hero.what: Headings step up by at least 1.25, with hero moments and a separate display scale

work-tool.name: Dense work tool
work-tool.why: Premium B2B work tools used all day share six traits; feel words such as professional or minimal otherwise push corners to 2px, labels to the body weight and the accent to grey, a look the evidence does not support.

corners.what: Controls 6px, cards and panels 8px, dialogs and popovers 12px
corners.note: Inferred: the floor value: the lower edge of the 6px roundness band (38-47).

weights.what: Three weights: body 400, labels, column headers and row titles 500, headings 600

accent.what: One colored accent for selection, links and focus (the placeholder blue until a brand color is given); the primary button may stay ink
accent.note: Inferred: the floor value: Material's Expressive anchor (HCT chroma 48), the lowest anchor at which links and focus read as color at a glance.

surfaces.what: Static cards and panels separate by a 1px ring with no shadow; shadows stay on menus, popovers, dialogs and toasts

rules: 35% dimming under clear glass on bright content

build.note: thick borders and a solid offset shadow (4px, blur 0, the strongest text color); 3px sits in styles.md's 2-4px range [inferred]
paired light and dark soft shadows; pressed swaps both to inset; offsets and blurs from styles.md [inferred]

color.space: oklch (hct when feeding Material dynamic color)
color.betweenSteps: steps 1-7 evenly spaced in lightness between background and step 8 [inferred]
color.chroma: accentChroma * curve(step), peak at step 9, clamped to gamut; if flags.brandExact: peak = max(accentChroma, chroma(brandColor))
color.brandAnchor: brandColor placed at nearest-lightness step; bg.brand = nearest step with >=4.5:1 against white or black text; if contrast(brand,white)<3 use dark on-color or tint only

neutral.hue: warmth-derived, or brand hue if flags.tintTowardBrand

dark.method: separate dark neutral ramp; map by role keeping light-mode contrast relationship

type.size: round(base * ratio^n), n from -2 to N

displayReach.note: marketing surfaces keep the product reach for UI text and get a separate fluid display scale (display below)

sfPro._about: Apple's tracking table for SF Pro, size in points to tracking in 1/1000 em (iOS, iPadOS and visionOS; macOS has the same values). Q-type-13 size-table uses it, interpolated between rows. SF Pro switches from its Text to its Display design at 20 pt, and the positive values from 24 pt correct the tighter Display drawing, so another typeface takes the table only up to textUntil.

jobs._about: One value per job, in em. Capitals never take negative tracking: display capitals 0 to +0.02em, small capital labels +0.05 to +0.08em. Exported as font.tracking.* and in every text style.
jobs.basis: Spectrum 2 detail (uppercase) style 0.06em (S-L02-021); a private B2B landing page tracked capital headings -0.03em (2026-11-05)

display._about: Marketing surfaces (Persuade, Experience) get a display scale of their own, fluid between a phone and the container width. display.lg is the hero (one per page, at most two lines); display.md is a section title. The UI scale stays as the feel sets it.
display.basis: owner, 2026-11-05: section titles of 54-60px read as too big three times; the engine's 83px single scale gave no hero
display.zoom: max stays under 2.5 x min (minOfMax 0.42 gives 2.3-2.4), so text zoomed to 200% still grows (WCAG 1.4.4; rem in the clamp)

pageLimits._about: Caps a page built from the system keeps. The engine writes them to opendesigner.meta.json (limits) so a review can count a page against them.
pageLimits.basis: a private B2B landing page had 20 sizes at 18px and below, five families and six text greys (2026-11-05)

space.semantic: aliases point at ladder indexes; density mode shifts index by -1/0/+1
space.innerLessThanOuter: inner gap <= one step below outer and <= half of it

radius.nested: inner = max(outer - padding, smallest non-zero step)

continuous._about: Apple's continuous corner (SwiftUI RoundedRectangle, style .continuous) drawn on the web with CSS corner-shape (Q-shape-04 squircle-enhance). In CSS Borders 4, superellipse(K) is x^(2^K) + y^(2^K) = 1; drawn at radiusScale times the token radius it follows Apple's curve to within maxError of the radius, and like Apple's curve it eases into the straight edge. A plain circular arc at the token radius is within circleError of Apple's curve; squircle (superellipse(2)) at the token radius is squircleError off, squarer than iOS. Figma draws it with corner smoothing.
continuous.method: tools/fit_corner.py: SwiftUI's own path, sampled on macOS, against the CSS curve; the farthest distance between them, in units of the radius

unchosen._about: Feel words and coupling never make a square or a pill control on their own: those are choices (Q-shape-01, a preset or a style). A control under raiseBelow px becomes to px; one above max becomes max.
unchosen.basis: owner, 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05: "too rounded, make them subtly rounded"; "the CTAs should be tried to not be kept rounded all the time"

roles.control: buttons and CTAs, inputs, selects, chips, toggles, tabs, carousel arrows
roles.person: avatars, dots and status pips only
roles.rule: the same kind of thing takes one corner everywhere

motion.web: if dampingRatio<1 emit sampled linear() spring; else cubic-bezier by energy band
motion.reducedMotion: token mode: travel->opacity/color, keep feedback, travel durations 0

layout._about: One container per site; columns, gutters and margins by width class; a reading measure. Tokens under layout.*.
layout.alignment: A centred hero is fine; within a section the heading and its content share one alignment.

lintErrors: target < 24x24 CSS px without spacing exception
leftToPerson: which element matters most per screen
golden ratio, color-wheel harmonies, 60-30-10 (optional presets only)

referenceIntake.principle: run section B formulas backwards; copy structure and quality, never identity

url.reads: computed CSS incl. transitions and linear() springs

figma.reads: variables incl. timing/easing, styles, effects, prototype motion

screenshot.reads: colors, areas, approx sizes and radii, depth cues, colorfulness/complexity metrics

density.from: body size, control heights, the gap between blocks of text in type sizes and the share of the height left blank (each space measure counts 1.5 against body size 1)

depth.from: shadow layers/alpha, borders, surface steps, backdrop blur

colorfulness.from: share of the page painted in colour (3 parts) and accent chroma (2 parts); surface chroma, accent count

warmth.from: neutral OKLCH hue and chroma; capitalization and contractions

energy.from: UI transition durations (multiplier = median medium / 275ms), curves, overshoot; colour fades alone read calm; loops that always run count by their easing, never their length; saturation, heading weight

expression.from: L09 X rubric levers minus what character dials explain

brandPresence.reason: expresses the person's intent; copying it copies identity

inversions.typeScale: least-squares fit of log(size)=log(base)+n*log(ratio); large residuals -> keep sizes as overrides; constant/stepped differences -> additive
inversions.spacing: largest of 4,5,8 dividing most values; ladder coverage; inner:outer from nested groups
inversions.color: split neutrals/accents; test equal contrast vs equal lightness per step to pick ramp rule (DC-L01-03)
inversions.shadow: parse layers: 0-blur 1px spread = ring; small+large blur pair = key+ambient; alpha -> depth position
inversions.motion: nearest A4 curve by control-point distance; overshoot -> damping < 1
inversions.icons: stroke vs size -> implied weight via icon formula; linecap and fill -> roundness and expression cues

neverCopied: exact brand hue (ask for own brand color; offer hue family as labeled suggestion)
proprietary or restricted typefaces (swap for open face of same classification)
logos, illustration, photography, custom icons, signature assets (to designer hooks)

beyondDials: type ratio 1.125 needs an override (dial gives 1.333)
35-shape library and shape morph are assets
concentric corners and capsule controls come from the platform, not the radius table
additive type formula selected as scale method
control md is 40 in Carbon; the dense band gives 32 (Carbon sm)
per-platform type ramps need platform modes
bevelled button shadows are a signature asset
body weight 450 is a variable-font override
heading weight 653 is a variable-font override
spring on avatar hover is a hand-placed hero moment
needs the separate primary-action color input
focus color, 5px unit and motion-off are raw inputs
thick black borders need strong signifiers
app values not public; recipe partly inferred
larger radius on large controls (opposite of the small-control drop)
photo-first imagery is content, not tokens

feelWords.about: Plain words people use for the feel, mapped onto the twelve macros (L06 4.2 rows) [inferred]. The engine accepts these; for any other word it says it does not know the word yet and asks, and never rejects the answer.
